comment: Instruction-level patches applied by the recompiler (tools/lib/codegen.mjs). Each one reads a runtime variable from runtime/src/recomp_rt.h; the variables default to values that reproduce the original instruction exactly.

spriteCull.comment: Sprite pieces are dropped unless (X - $60) <= $160 unsigned, i.e. screen x in [-32, 320]. These compares add patch_cull_left to the register value and patch_cull_widen to the limit, so widescreen keeps pieces in the side areas. The register itself is not changed.

cameraClamp.comment: Horizontal camera limits (sub at $00CF..): the camera x is clamped to [0, ($FF177A)]. These three instructions use cam_margin() instead, a runtime value that is 0 without widescreen, so the wider screen stops at the map edges too.

playerDamage.comment: The player's hit handler subtracts the damage from the current HP ($8A of the player object at $FF19E8) here. With patch_no_damage set (the infinite health cheat) the damage is 0, so even a hit bigger than the whole health bar cannot kill.
